subject: Reference call request for MerchantPlus retail pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Moss <claire.moss@merchantplus.com>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@merchantplus.com>
Cc: procurement@merchantplus.com
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reference call request for MerchantPlus retail pilot

Hi Claire / Amit,

Thanks again for the time today — excited about the pilot opportunity. As discussed on the call, MerchantPlus is in late-stage negotiations and the buying committee has asked for 1–2 short, industry-matched reference conversations focused on:

- Omnichannel retail with >500 stores (mid-market to enterprise)
- POS and returns integration experience (Clover/Oracle/Toast integrations is a plus)
- Production traffic patterns (burst events; peak hour latency)
- A quick 20–30 minute call sometime next week would be ideal.

To make scheduling easy I attached a short reference questionnaire that outlines the typical topics we cover (reference-questionnaire.pdf). If you can confirm the profile you prefer (region, preferred use-case emphasis), I’ll match two customers and coordinate availability. If procurement needs a consent form from the reference customer, we can circulate that as well.

Mutual action plan (suggested):
1) Confirm reference profile & priority (you)
2) Redwood proposes 2 candidates + short brief (within 24 hours)
3) Book 20–30 min call(s) next week
4) Post-call recap and capture quotes/testimonial (if agreeable)

High level deal context for reference selection: this is a US retail pilot to validate speed of returns reconciliation and checkout latency under live POS load — deal owner: Jordan Blake, expected ARR $1.2M (annual commitment).

Suggested timeslots (PDT): Tue 8/22 10:00–12:00, Wed 8/23 13:00–16:00, Thu 8/24 09:00–11:00. Let me know which window works or share a preferred calendar link and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looping you in to keep things moving.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

--- attachment stub: reference-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 1 page) ---

From: Claire Moss <claire.moss@merchantplus.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@merchantplus.com>, procurement@merchantplus.com
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:01:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Reference call request for MerchantPlus retail pilot

Jordan — thanks for the clear plan. We can do next week; the buying committee wants references that map to the following prioritization:

1) US omnichannel merchant (500–2,000 stores) with a heavy returns volume.
2) Customer that runs dedicated GPU capacity / private deployment (we care about data isolation).
3) Preferably has integrated with our POS stack (we use Oracle Retail and some legacy Clover integrations).

A couple of quick Qs:
- Do you have customers that consent to a recorded call? Procurement may ask for an executed consent form before the session.
- Are you able to provide a one-pager that highlights what we should ask the reference (topics + suggested prompts)?

Availability: Wed 8/23 14:00–15:00 ET or Thu 8/24 11:00–12:00 ET. If you can propose exact slots in ET we’ll confirm.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Moss
Head of Product, MerchantPlus
claire.moss@merchantplus.com | +1 646 555 8890

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Moss <claire.moss@merchantplus.com>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@merchantplus.com>, procurement@merchantplus.com
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Reference call request for MerchantPlus retail pilot — need candidate shortlist (urgent)

Laura / Vanessa — forwarding Claire's note. MerchantPlus (deal MP-2028-019) is a late-stage pilot (expected ARR ~$1.2M). They want a US omnichannel retail reference, 500–2,000 stores, with returns-heavy traffic and a private/dedicated deployment story if possible. They use Oracle/Clover stack.

Can we fast-track two candidates who meet the profile and have consents on file? Ideally: BrightCart (mid-market, private deployment) and a backup with strong POS integration stories. If BrightCart is good, can you:
- Confirm Jenna Lee (VP Ops, BrightCart) is willing and provide a 1–2 line intro + availability
- Generate the one-pager talking points and send the consent form (BrightCart-consent.pdf)
- Coordinate scheduling against MerchantPlus slots (Claire suggested Wed 8/23 14:00–15:00 ET or Thu 8/24 11:00–12:00 ET)

Quote from Claire's email: 
> the buying committee wants references that map to the following prioritization:
> 1) US omnichannel merchant (500–2,000 stores) with a heavy returns volume.
> 2) Customer that runs dedicated GPU capacity / private deployment (we care about data isolation).
> 3) Preferably has integrated with our POS stack (we use Oracle Retail and some legacy Clover integrations).

We have tight timing on this — MerchantPlus is aiming to close within two weeks. Vanessa, can you take lead on logistics and Laura, can you assemble candidate briefs by EOD? I’ve attached our internal notes from the RFP thread (MerchantPlus-RFP-notes.pdf).

Thanks — Jordan

--- forwarded attachment stub: MerchantPlus-RFP-notes.pdf (doc, 2 pages) ---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, Claire Moss <claire.moss@merchantplus.com>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@merchantplus.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 07:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Reference call request for MerchantPlus retail pilot — candidate shortlist

All — quick update and proposed candidates. BrightCart (Jenna Lee) is available and has consented to speak; I confirmed verbally this morning. Backup candidate is Gridline Retail (Carlos Mendez) — can also speak to POS integrations and returns flow.

Candidate 1 — BrightCart (preferred)
- Contact: Jenna Lee <jenna.lee@brightcart.com>
- Role: VP Operations
- Fit: 700 stores, omnichannel, heavy returns processing, integrated with Oracle Retail and a custom POS adapter; private/dedicated deployment for order reconciliation
- Willingness: Consent to recorded call and short testimonial; completed our advocate consent form (attached: BrightCart-consent.pdf)
- Suggested talking points (short):
  - Why they chose Redwood for production inference (throughput & reliability)
  - Deployment model: private/dedicated and reasons for isolation
  - Real metrics: peak hour token throughput, average tail latency reductions after tuning, and reduction in returns reconciliation time
  - Runbook/ops: how Redwood’s observability helped detect regressions during a holiday spike

Candidate 2 — Gridline Retail (backup)
- Contact: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@gridline.com>
- Role: Director, Platform Engineering
- Fit: 1,200 stores across US & Canada; strong POS integration experience; runs dedicated capacity

Proposed slots (ET) to offer MerchantPlus:
- Wed 8/23 14:00–14:30 ET (BrightCart)
- Wed 8/23 14:30–15:00 ET (Gridline backup)
- Thu 8/24 11:00–11:30 ET (BrightCart alternative)

I attached the BrightCart consent form and I can send a one-pager with the suggested prompts in a follow-up within the hour. Vanessa, I’ve copied in the contact details and Jenna’s availability (she prefers mornings PT).

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Customer Advocacy Lead | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199
